status: DRAFT - not approved by Gary, NOT wired into game code
palette: art/world/overworld/palette.hex (64 colours) + full transparency; alpha is 0 or 255 only
scale_rule: draw 1x frames scaled by an integer (2x/3x) with nearest-neighbour only; *_2x files are exact nearest copies
sheet_layout: horizontal strip; frame i rect = [i*w, 0, w, h] (rects[] lists them)
emissive_rule: emissive 'all' -> grade with grades.<g>.lit (lut_<g>_lit.png); 'none' -> grades.<g>.sprite; 'mask' -> per pixel by <name>_emissive_sheet.png. Draw order: palette swaps -> grade.
about: Overworld item pickup FX (MECHANICS_PARITY F18): supply satchel prop, pickup open, hidden-item sparkle. Original soft drawstring supply bag with a violet crystal toggle bead (no ball/orb motif, no case/briefcase shape).

pickup.hidden_variant: pickup_open with no satchel: code draws only the light/sparkle pixels (they are the emissive-mask pixels of frames 1-8)

hooks.layering: satchel_idle draws as a y-sorted prop (feet = tile bottom); pickup_open uses the same sort key; hidden_sparkle above ground, below the player
hooks.ownership: The supply bag is a map PROP and World Design may own the final prop art. This soft-bag draft is the Animator reference; if World Design paints the prop, point satchel_idle at their tile and keep pickup_open (the light/sparkle pixels still work over it).
hooks.reduced_motion: satchel glint off; pickup_open frames 0,3,7; hidden sparkle keeps playing (it is the hint) but at size 2 max

idle_grass.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5

pickup.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5

hidden.rule: fraction of FX pixels with |dLuma|>=28 vs graded background under them, per phase; pass >= 0.5

anchor.meaning: top-left of the item tile (64x64, prop sits bottom-centre)

satchel_idle.notes: Supply satchel prop (visible item, solid). Soft drawstring bag; the crystal toggle bead glints every ~2 s. Emissive mask = bead + glint only; the cloth uses the sprite grade.

anchor.meaning: canvas (0,32) = top-left of the item tile; 32 px headroom above

pickup_open.notes: Player faces + A: the cord loosens, the neck opens, a light rises and pops into a ring of sparkles, the satchel dithers away (Bayer, no poof/smoke). Show the "found X" text on frame 4; remove the solid prop collision on frame 7.

anchor.meaning: centre; draw at tile px (32,40) + jitter

hidden_sparkle.notes: Hidden-item hint. Plays once every ~6 s while the player is within 2 tiles (Chebyshev). Facing + A picks it up; then play pickup_open frames 1-8 without the satchel (code: skip the satchel layer).
